cca_quizzes_v2.description: Comprehensive 10th Class Mathematics Master Bank assessment covering basic algebraic identities, trinomial expansions, cubic formulas, and difference of squares (Q1 – Q10). Strictly aligned with BISE Past Papers.

questions.questionText: The expansion of the basic algebraic identity (a + b)² is equal to:
questions.explanation: Standard expansion: (a + b)² = (a + b)(a + b) = a² + 2ab + b².

questions.questionText: The algebraic formula (a - b)² expands to:
questions.explanation: Standard binomial difference formula: (a - b)² = a² - 2ab + b².

questions.questionText: The factorization of the difference of two squares (a² - b²) is:
questions.explanation: Difference of two squares identity: a² - b² = (a - b)(a + b).

questions.questionText: The identity (a + b)² + (a - b)² simplifies to:
questions.explanation: (a² + 2ab + b²) + (a² - 2ab + b²) = 2a² + 2b² = 2(a² + b²).

questions.questionText: The identity (a + b)² - (a - b)² is identically equal to:
questions.explanation: (a² + 2ab + b²) - (a² - 2ab + b²) = 4ab.

questions.questionText: The complete expansion of the trinomial square (a + b + c)² is:
options: a² + b² + c² + ab + bc + ca
questions.explanation: Standard trinomial identity for the square of sum of three terms: (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca.

questions.questionText: The cubic expansion of a sum of two terms (a + b)³ is given by:
questions.explanation: (a + b)³ = a³ + 3a²b + 3ab² + b³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b).

questions.questionText: The cubic expansion of (a - b)³ is given by:
questions.explanation: (a - b)³ = a³ - 3a²b + 3ab² - b³ = a³ - b³ - 3ab(a - b).

questions.questionText: The factorization formula for a³ + b³ is:
questions.explanation: Sum of cubes identity: a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² - ab + b²).

questions.questionText: The factorization formula for a³ - b³ is:
questions.explanation: Difference of cubes identity: a³ - b³ = (a - b)(a² + ab + b²).

questions.questionText: Identify the grammatically correct sentence in Present Perfect Continuous Tense:
options: He has been living here since five years.
He has been living here for five years.
He is living here since five years.
He lived here for five years.
questions.explanation: "For" is used to denote an unspecified period or duration (five years), whereas "since" denotes a specific point in time.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct preposition: "The cadet is fond ___ flying aircraft."
questions.explanation: The adjective "fond" takes the dependent preposition "of" (fond of doing something).

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an Abstract Noun?
questions.explanation: Bravery represents a quality, virtue, or intangible concept that cannot be touched physically, making it an abstract noun.

questions.questionText: Select the word with the correct spelling:
questions.explanation: Accommodation is spelled with double "c" and double "m".

questions.questionText: Fill in the blank: "Neither the captain nor the crew members ___ present at the debriefing."
questions.explanation: When subjects are joined by "neither... nor", the verb agrees with the closer subject ("crew members" is plural, requiring "were").

questions.questionText: "The sun rises in the east." The verb "rises" in this sentence is:
questions.explanation: An intransitive verb does not take a direct object; "in the east" is an adverbial prepositional phrase.

questions.questionText: Choose the sentence with correct punctuation:
options: Alas! We have lost the match.
Alas, we have lost the match!
Alas. We have lost the match!
Alas? We have lost the match.
questions.explanation: Interjections conveying deep sorrow or emotion (such as "Alas!") require an exclamation mark immediately following the word.

questions.questionText: Complete the conditional sentence: "If it rains tomorrow, we ___ the sports gala."
questions.explanation: First conditional formula: If + Simple Present (rains), will + base verb (will cancel) for probable future conditions.

questions.questionText: Choose the closest synonym for the word "COURAGEOUS":
questions.explanation: "Valiant" means bold, courageous, or exhibiting bravery, exactly matching the definition of courageous.

questions.questionText: "The pen is mightier than the sword." Which figure of speech is exemplified here?
questions.explanation: Metonymy replaces the name of a thing with something closely associated with it ("pen" represents written communication, "sword" represents military warfare).

questions.questionText: Change the voice: "The pilot landed the fighter jet safely."
options: The fighter jet was landed safely by the pilot.
The fighter jet is landed safely by the pilot.
The fighter jet had been landed safely by the pilot.
The pilot was landed safely by the fighter jet.
questions.explanation: Simple past tense active ("landed") transforms into past passive: was/were + past participle ("was landed").

questions.questionText: Change into Indirect Speech: He said, "I have done my duty."
options: He said that he has done his duty.
He said that he had done his duty.
He told that he did his duty.
He says that he had done his duty.
questions.explanation: With a past tense reporting verb ("said"), present perfect ("have done") shifts back to past perfect ("had done").

questions.questionText: What is the antonym of the word "EXPAND"?

questions.questionText: Identify the conjunction in this sentence: "He worked diligently, yet he failed to secure the top badge."
questions.explanation: "Yet" is an adversative coordinating conjunction connecting two independent clauses.

questions.questionText: What is the plural form of the noun "Crisis"?
questions.explanation: Nouns of classical Greek origin ending in -is change to -es in their plural form (crisis -> crises).

questions.questionText: What is the feminine gender term for a young horse ("Colt")?
questions.explanation: A young male horse is a colt; a young female horse is a filly (a mature female horse is a mare).

questions.questionText: Fill in the blank: "Hardly had we reached the airfield ___ the storm broke out."
questions.explanation: The correlative conjunction structure is "Hardly... when" (or "Scarcely... when"), not "than".

questions.questionText: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: "To burn the midnight oil"
options: To work or study late into the night
To set fire to household items
To fall asleep during guard duty
questions.explanation: The idiom refers to working diligently or studying well into the late night hours.

questions.questionText: Choose the sentence with the correct natural order of adjectives:
questions.explanation: Standard English adjective sequence follows: Size (big) -> Color (red) -> Proper Origin (Pakistani).

questions.questionText: "Whose flight bag is this?" In this sentence, the word "Whose" functions as an:

questions.questionText: An article purchased for Rs. 800 is sold for Rs. 1000. What is the profit percentage?
questions.explanation: Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price = 1000 - 800 = 200. Profit % = (200 / 800) * 100 = 25%.

questions.questionText: Find the compound ratio of 2:3 and 6:7.

questions.questionText: Calculate the simple interest on a principal of Rs. 5000 at 6% per annum for 3 years.

questions.questionText: The arithmetic average of 5 consecutive odd numbers is 25. What is the smallest of these numbers?
questions.explanation: In 5 consecutive odd numbers, the average equals the middle (3rd) number: 25. The numbers are 21, 23, 25, 27, 29; smallest is 21.

questions.questionText: What is the sum of all interior angles of a quadrilateral?

questions.questionText: In a right-angled triangle, the base is 6 cm and perpendicular is 8 cm. What is the length of the hypotenuse?

questions.questionText: Find the volume of a solid cube having an edge length of 5 cm:
questions.explanation: Volume of cube = edge³ = 5 * 5 * 5 = 125 cm³.

questions.questionText: What is the formula for the total surface area of a closed right circular cylinder of radius r and height h?
questions.explanation: Total surface area = curved surface area (2πrh) + 2 circular bases (2πr²) = 2πr(r + h).

questions.questionText: If the perimeter of a square field is 48 cm, what is its enclosed area?
questions.explanation: Side length of square = Perimeter / 4 = 48 / 4 = 12 cm. Area = 12² = 144 cm².

questions.questionText: An angle whose measure is strictly greater than 90° and less than 180° is termed an:

questions.questionText: In an observed statistical data sample, the value that occurs with the highest frequency is called the:

questions.questionText: Find the median of the following set of test scores: 4, 8, 2, 9, 6, 5, 7.

questions.questionText: When white light enters a triangular glass prism, it disperses into seven spectral colors. This optical phenomenon is called:

questions.questionText: Which of the following substances is a superior conductor of electrical current?
questions.explanation: Copper is a metallic element with abundant free conduction electrons that facilitate electric charge flow.

questions.questionText: Which scientific instrument is utilized to measure atmospheric pressure?
questions.explanation: A barometer measures atmospheric air pressure (in mmHg or hectopascals).

questions.questionText: Thermal energy transfer occurring through solids predominantly takes place by:
questions.explanation: In solids, heat transfers predominantly via conduction through atomic and lattice vibrations without mass movement.

questions.questionText: What is the speed of light propagating in a vacuum?
questions.explanation: Light in a vacuum travels at an approximate fundamental speed of 300,000,000 m/s or 3 × 10⁸ m/s.

questions.questionText: A concave mirror forms what type of image when an object is positioned at optical infinity?
questions.explanation: Parallel incident rays from infinity converge exactly at the mirror's principal focus, creating a real, inverted, point-sized/diminished image.

questions.questionText: In an electrical testing circuit, an ammeter must always be connected in:
questions.explanation: An ammeter has very low internal resistance and must be wired in series so that the full loop current traverses it.

questions.questionText: In physical mechanics, mechanical Work is defined as the product of Force and:
questions.explanation: Work = Force × Displacement in the directional vector of applied force (W = F · d).

cca_quizzes_v2.title: PAF College Sargodha — General Science: Chemistry & Biology (Part 2)
cca_quizzes_v2.subject: General Science
cca_quizzes_v2.description: Class VIII Entrance Examination - General Science Paper assessing cellular biology, chemical reactions, environmental science, and physiology.

questions.questionText: Which eukaryotic cellular organelle is universally termed the "powerhouse of the cell"?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria synthesize cellular ATP through aerobic cellular respiration, fueling metabolic activities.

questions.questionText: What is the chemical composition formula of hydrated Rust?
questions.explanation: Rust is hydrated ferric oxide, chemically designated as Fe₂O₃·nH₂O.

questions.questionText: Which atmospheric greenhouse gas is the principal contributor to anthropogenic global warming?
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) traps radiated infrared energy within the troposphere, driving the greenhouse effect.

questions.questionText: The biological loss of water vapor from plant foliage through microscopic stomata is known as:
questions.explanation: Transpiration is the evaporation of excess water through foliar stomatal pores that also creates the transpirational pull.

questions.questionText: What is the pH value of pure deionized water at standard 25°C?
questions.explanation: At 25°C, [H⁺] equals [OH⁻] in neutral pure water, yielding a neutral pH of exactly 7.

questions.questionText: Which of the following processes represents an irreversible Chemical Change?
questions.explanation: Rusting of iron chemically combines iron and oxygen into iron oxide, producing a new chemical compound.

questions.questionText: How many muscular chambers does the human heart contain?
questions.explanation: The human heart is quadricameral: consisting of two receiving atria and two pumping ventricles.

questions.questionText: Which inorganic acid is secreted in the gastric mucosa of the human stomach to facilitate protein digestion?
questions.explanation: Parietal cells secrete dilute Hydrochloric acid (HCl) to activate pepsinogen and maintain gastric acidity.

questions.questionText: In human respiratory physiology, the essential exchange of O₂ and CO₂ occurs inside:
questions.explanation: Alveoli are thin-walled, vascularized air sacs across whose epithelial membrane gas diffusion takes place.

questions.questionText: Which atomic subatomic particle carries a negative elementary charge (-1)?
questions.explanation: Electrons orbit the atomic nucleus and possess a negative fundamental electric charge.

cca_quizzes_v2.subject: Urdu
cca_quizzes_v2.description: Class VIII Entrance Examination - Urdu Paper assessing literary comprehension, grammar rules, proverbs, and vocabulary.

questions.questionText: علامہ محمد اقبال کی پہلی اردو شعری تصنیف کون سی ہے؟
questions.explanation: علامہ محمد اقبال کا پہلا اردو شعری مجموعہ "بانگِ درا" ہے جو 1924ء میں طبع ہوا۔

questions.questionText: لفظ "روشنی" کا متضاد لفظ کیا ہے؟
questions.explanation: روشنی کا متضاد (الٹ) لفظ تاریکی یا اندھیرا ہے۔

questions.questionText: قواعد کی رو سے جملہ "احمد تیز دوڑتا ہے" میں لفظ "تیز" کیا ہے؟
questions.explanation: لفظ "تیز" فعل "دوڑتا ہے" کی رفتار اور انداز بیان کر رہا ہے، لہٰذا یہ متعلق فعل (Adverb) ہے۔

questions.questionText: درج ذیل میں سے درست املا کا انتخاب کیجیے:
questions.explanation: لفظ "ضرورت" عربی الاصل ہے اور ضاد سے لکھا جاتا ہے، درست املا "ضرورت مند" ہے۔

questions.questionText: ضرب المثل مکمل کیجیے: "ناچ نہ جانے ___ ٹیڑھا"
questions.explanation: مشہور اردو ضرب المثل ہے: "ناچ نہ جانے آنگن ٹیڑھا" یعنی اپنی کمزوری چھپانے کے لیے ماحول کو قصوروار ٹھہرانا۔

questions.questionText: لفظ "کتاب" کی عربی جمع مکسر کیا ہے؟
questions.explanation: عربی جمع مکسر کے وزن پر لفظ "کتاب" کی جمع "کُتُب" ہے۔

questions.questionText: "شیر کی طرح بہادر" میں علمِ بیان کی کون سی قسم استعمال ہوئی ہے؟
questions.explanation: کسی مشترک صفت کی بنا پر ایک چیز کو دوسری چیز کے مشابہ قرار دینا تشبیہ کہلاتا ہے (حرفِ تشبیہ: "کی طرح")۔

questions.questionText: "شاعرِ مشرق" اور "حکیم الامت" کن کا معروف و محترم لقب ہے؟
questions.explanation: ڈاکٹر علامہ محمد اقبال کو ان کے بلند پایہ فکری پیغام کے اعتراف میں "شاعرِ مشرق" کا عظیم لقب حاصل ہے۔

questions.questionText: وہ کلمہ جو کسی کام کے کرنے یا ہونے کو ظاہر کرے مگر اس میں کوئی زمانہ نہ پایا جائے، کیا کہلاتا ہے؟
questions.explanation: اسمِ مصدر وہ کلمہ ہے جو بذاتِ خود کام کا مفہوم ادا کرے لیکن زمانے سے خالی ہو (جیسے کھانا، پینا، پڑھنا)۔

questions.questionText: "آسمان پر دماغ ہونا" محاورے کا صحیح مفہوم کیا ہے؟
questions.explanation: یہ اردو کا مستعمل محاورہ ہے جس کا مطلب شدید تکبر، نخوت یا غرور میں مبتلا ہونا ہے۔
